alphaxiv.name: alphaXiv
alphaxiv.description: Finds arXiv research, reads papers' full text, searches citations and researchers, and explores papers' code repositories.
alphaxiv.access: Needs an alphaXiv API key, created under Settings > API Keys on alphaxiv.org. With it, the model can also change your alphaXiv library and followed researchers.
alphaxiv.dataDestination: Searches, paper requests, and library changes are sent to api.alphaxiv.org.

setup.advice: Sign in, open API Keys, and create a key.
